category_title: Students who work ahead and disrupt lessons with frequent procedural questions
scenario_title: Working ahead and disrupting group instruction
minimal_context: The student is working ahead independently in a self-contained unit workbook while the teacher leads a group discussion on the board.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You can continue working ahead independently in your unit workbook while I record the joint working on the board for the rest of the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Excuse me Miss . . . do I need to copy the problems down or just write the answers?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do what you think is right.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Excuse me Miss . . . I'm on the next page now, what am I supposed to do for this section?

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please keep trying to work through it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Excuse me Miss . . . I'm working ahead at a faster pace and I need you to tell me the procedure for the next unit.
